summary: Iter-29 backend + frontend verification of TRELPNG Phase 1 Source/Run infrastructure. Backend pytest 14/14 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter29_source_runs.py) covering: (a) MarketSource extended fields (collection_frequency/parser_version/last_run_at/last_successful_run_at/consecutive_failures) round-trip on POST + GET /admin/market/sources; (b) POST /admin/market/runs/start returns CollectionRun {status:'running', run_type:'manual', triggered_by=user_id, listings_seen:0}; fails 404 on missing source and 400 on active=false source; (c) POST /admin/market/runs/{id}/listings batch ingest — first batch of 2 novel listings credits seen=2/new=2/updated=0/results=2; re-post of same source_listing_id with different price credits seen=3/new=2/updated=1 (dedup verified); (d) GET /admin/market/listings/{id}/snapshots returns ≥2 rows after price change (first_seen + price change), both prices {250000, 275000} present; (e) POST /admin/market/runs/{id}/finish — success: status='success', duration_ms populated (int), source.last_run_at + last_successful_run_at set + consecutive_failures reset to 0, audit event 'run_success' emitted; forced failed: status='failed', consecutive_failures=1, 'run_failed' event; subsequent successful finish resets streak to 0; 400 on ingest into finished run; 400 on double-finish; (f) GET /admin/market/sources/health returns all expected keys (runs, success_rate, error_rate, partial_rate, last_run_at, last_successful_run_at, consecutive_failures, avg_duration_ms, listings_last_run) with runs≥3 after test flow; (g) GET /admin/market/config/active?algorithm=combined includes parameters.retention={raw_source_data_days:365, normalized_data_days:730, review_case_days:365, audit_log_days:2555, soft_delete_only:true}. Frontend Playwright verified: /admin/market/sources shows all 6 new columns (Frequency/Parser/Success %/Runs/Fail streak/Last run) after adding a source; Add-Source modal has select-source-frequency dropdown (manual/hourly/daily/weekly) + input-source-parser text field; on save the row shows freq='daily' parser='1.0' Success%='—' Runs=0 (fresh source) — matches expected empty-state; clicking 'Run' triggers POST /runs/start and shows toast 'Run started — …'. /admin/market/config renders the new 'Data Retention' tab as the 5th tab; on click the 4 numeric inputs are pre-populated with 365/730/365/2555 and the 'Soft delete only' checkbox is checked by default. DB left clean at end: 0 market_sources, 0 market_listings, 0 collection_runs, 0 property_matches, 9 trel_backfill master_properties preserved, orphaned audit events cleared.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/market.py::finish_run does NOT emit run_partial audit — the docstring/requirement asks for run_success/run_failed/run_partial. Current code emits `run_{status}` so if status resolves to 'partial' (errors captured but not forced-failed) the event is 'run_partial' — correct. However when caller forces status='failed' but the run had prior errors accumulated during ingestion, the current code counts the run as failed which is correct; edge case OK.

routes/market.py::finish_run — when status='partial', consecutive_failures is NOT touched (neither reset nor incremented). Verified in code. If the intent is 'partial should not reset streak but also not extend it', the current implementation matches. Confirm this is intentional (algorithm doc §Phase-1 doesn't specify).

routes/market.py::finish_run — duration_ms is derived from `datetime.fromisoformat(run['started_at'])`; if started_at was stored via now_iso() format, verify it is ISO-parseable across all environments (fromisoformat handles 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS' and '+00:00' formats since Py3.11). Consider adding a fallback to time.time() delta if parse fails (currently returns None silently).

routes/market.py::ingest_batch reads/writes counters by copying from run doc into RunContext, but subsequent `ctx.ingest()` calls issue an update_one per item — for large batches this is N round-trips. Consider a bulk update on batch completion.

Sources.jsx table only renders <thead> when rows.length > 0 — empty-state hides column definitions. Not a defect, but a test that inspects columns must first ensure at least one source exists. Consider showing column headers even in empty state so QA and users understand the schema.

Sources.jsx `triggerRun` does not disable the Run button while inflight — a double-click could start 2 concurrent runs against the same source (backend does NOT reject overlapping runs). Consider either a disabled flag or a server-side single-run-per-source guard.
core/runs.py::_finalise_run vs routes/market.py::finish_run duplicate the source-health patch logic — extract to a helper to keep behavior in lockstep as fields evolve.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: 2 TEST_ITER29_SRC_* market_sources + 1 TEST_UI_ITER29 (frontend) source, ~2 test market_listings under those sources, 3 collection_runs, first_seen + price-change snapshots.
